Not sent

Your message did not reach the moderator. Find the reason below. Each reason says what to do, and you can always send your report or request by email instead.

The files are too large

The form takes at most 10 MB of files in total. Choose fewer or smaller screenshots, or send the larger ones by email.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

Too many files

The form takes at most 10 files. Choose the ones that show the most, or send the rest by email.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

A file is not an image

The form takes PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP images only. Remove every other file, for example a PDF or a document. Never send the file you were asked to run: write its SHA-256 hash in the text instead.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

A required field is empty

A field marked required held nothing, or only spaces or invisible characters. Fill in every required field and send it again.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

A text is too long

A text is longer than its field allows. The hint under each field gives its limit. Shorten the text, or send it by email.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

The email address does not work

Check your email address for typing errors. It needs a name, an @ and a domain, without spaces.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

The page URL is not a page of this site

Copy the address of the page on interviewscam.com from your browser's address bar, exactly as it appears there, and send it again.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

Too many attempts

The form takes at most 6 attempts an hour, and at most 3 sent messages a day, from one network. Try again later, after 00:00 UTC if 3 messages went out today, or send it by email now.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

The form is paused for today

The form takes a limited number of messages a day, and today's are used up. It opens again at 00:00 UTC. Send it by email now instead.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

The form could not accept this message

The message did not come from the form on this site as it is, or a field that people never see was filled in. Go back and send it from the form again, or send it by email.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com

Something went wrong

The message could not be sent because of an error on the site's side. Try again later, or send it by email now.

If you go back to the form, choose your files again: the browser does not keep them.

Email address for reports and requests: report@interviewscam.com
